press_references.value: du and Huawei Launch SME Digital Playbook to Improve Business Operations

product_launches.description: du launched the From Set Up to Set for Growth digital transformation playbook for UAE small and medium-sized enterprises. Developed with Huawei UAE, it provides guidance on using existing technology, improving digital payments, protecting financial information, and applying practical AI tools to strengthen business operations.

press_references.value: Du Launchpad: UAE’s first super platform for SMEs to accelerate business growth

product_launches.description: du launched 'du Launchpad', an AI-powered all-in-one super platform under its du Business portfolio that integrates accounting, HR/payroll, tax filing, WhatsApp Business integration, invoicing and compliance workflows to help UAE SMEs streamline operations and reduce costs.

press_references.value: Du and Al Gharbia Pipe Company announce strategic partnership to advance industrial AI Vision technology across UAE manufacturing sector

product_launches.description: du and Al Gharbia Pipe Company presented their co-developed Industrial AI Vision Platform, an AI-based quality inspection and operational monitoring solution for manufacturing, showcasing it with interactive demonstrations to highlight its capabilities across UAE industrial operations.

press_references.value: Du announces enhanced connectivity support and services for SMEs and startups across the UAE

product_launches.description: du launched a business continuity initiative for SMEs and startups in the UAE, including enhanced connectivity support, exclusive offers, upgraded mobile plans and bundles, and upcoming innovative services to improve reliability and productivity.

press_references.value: Du launches "Bridging the Space Between Hearts " campaign to strengthen family connections during the holy month

product_launches.description: Telecom operator du launched its "Bridging the Space Between Hearts" Ramadan-themed marketing campaign built around a contemporary Arabic song and user-generated content to promote family connections.

press_references.value: du partners with Huawei to launch UAE's first multi-band indoor 5G solution

product_launches.description: du, in partnership with Huawei, launched the UAE's first customized multi-band indoor 5G Indoor Base Station solution using a pico Remote Radio Unit to enhance indoor coverage across key locations.

press_references.value: Gulf regulators reassign prime airwaves to strengthen 5G, LTE

product_launches.description: Kuwait operators Zain and Ooredoo, along with UAE operators du and e&, have launched 5G-Advanced services as part of the region's move toward 3GPP Release 18 networks.

press_references.value: Du launches AI Park and National Hybrid AI at GITEX 2025 to accelerate UAE's sovereign AI ambitions

product_launches.description: du unveiled the du AI Park in Dubai at GITEX 2025—an AI ecosystem anchored by liquid‑cooled hyperscale data centers targeting up to 1 GW capacity, with labs, incubators, and sovereign hybrid AI compute; phased rollout over five years.

press_references.value: Du partners with Microsoft, Nokia, Khalifa University, and ITU to launch region’s first Arabic Telecom LLM for Operational Excellence

product_launches.description: du, in partnership with Microsoft, Nokia, Khalifa University, and ITU, launched the region's first Arabic Telecom Large Language Model (LLM) designed for internal telecom operations, aiming to enhance efficiency and AI-driven innovation.

press_references.value: Du launches the National Hypercloud to offer sovereign cloud services in UAE for government entities

product_launches.description: du launched the National Hypercloud, a sovereign cloud platform designed to provide secure, scalable cloud services for UAE government entities, in partnership with Oracle. This platform supports digital transformation and AI-driven services in the UAE public sector.

overview_description.description: du is a telecom operator that offers mobile and fixed telephony, broadband connectivity, and IPTV services to individuals, homes, and businesses. They also provide carrier services for businesses and satellite up or downlink services for television broadcasters.

about_short_description.short_description: du is a telecommunication company that offers broadband connectivity and IPTV services for people, homes, and businesses.

product.name: Mobile Telecommunications Services
product.description: Mobile voice, messaging, and data connectivity for individual and business customers through cellular networks, including prepaid and postpaid plans.

product.name: Home Broadband Internet
product.description: Fixed broadband connectivity for homes, supporting internet access for web use, streaming, gaming, remote work, and connected devices.

product.name: IPTV and Home Entertainment
product.description: Television delivered over an internet connection, providing households with live channels and other video entertainment services.

identifier.value: Fixed Voice and Home Phone Services

product.name: Fixed Voice and Home Phone Services
product.description: Fixed-line voice communication for households and organizations, using du’s telecommunications network for local and other supported calls.

product.name: Business Internet and Connectivity
product.description: Internet access and network connectivity services for businesses, including fixed access used to connect offices, employees, and business applications.

product.name: Business Voice and Unified Communications
product.description: Voice and communications services for organizations, supporting business calling and collaboration across office, mobile, and remote users.
